channel.title: The Traitors
channel.desc: As the game continues, breakfast delivers a wake-up call for the Faithful, with the Traitors making their next dastardly move. The mission proves to be a living nightmare for the players, but can they hold their nerve? The nightmare continues at the Round Table as the Traitors try to deceive the Faithful into banishing one of their own. It's a simple question - who do you think is a Traitor? - but the answer is far more complex.
